dogecoin.text: Dogecoin ($DOGE) experiences a significant rise of 34% today, surpassing a market cap of $42 billion, marking a notable recovery in its valuation.

In a significant market shift, Dogecoin has re-flipped XRP, taking the lead in market capitalization. This development highlights the ongoing volatility and competition within the cryptocurrency space.
A Dogecoin whale has purchased 140 million DOGE, totaling approximately $56 million, in the last 24 hours, according to on-chain analyst Ali.
